info.title: The Selling Partner API for Support
info.description: The Selling Partner API for Support provides programmatic access to information about Selling Partner support.

post.description:

To get a complete list, call this operation until `nextToken` is null. Note that this operation can return empty pages.

cases.description: A paginated list of support cases.

caseId.description: A globally unique identifier for the case

status.description: The current status of the case.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Indicates that a case is resolved and requires no farther action.
Indicates that a case is transferred and future case details are no longer tracked in this case.
Indicates that the case is awaiting an action by the selling partner.
Indicates that the case is awaiting an action by Amazon.

primaryEmail.description: The primary email associated with the case.

ccEmails.description: Additional emails that are attached to the case.

createdDate.description: The time when the case was created. In [ISO 8601](https://developer-docs.amazon/sp-api/docs/iso-8601) format.

lastUpdatedDate.description: The time when the case was last updated, which includes updates to the case details and new contacts added to the case. In [ISO 8601](https://developer-docs.amazon/sp-api/docs/iso-8601) format.

resolvedDate.description: The time when the case was resolved. In [ISO 8601](https://developer-docs.amazon/sp-api/docs/iso-8601) format.

appointmentId.description: The unique identifier for the scheduled appointment.

answeringParty.description: The person who is expected to answer the call.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: The call should be routed through a receptionist
An appointment is currently scheduled for a future date.
A previously scheduled appointment was canceled and no contact will be created for it.
A previously scheduled appointment was unable to be completed.
A previously scheduled appointment was completed.

Appointment.description: An appointment for a contact at a future date.

countryCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 two-digit country code for the calling country.

extension.description: The extension to use for the call, if applicable.

earliestCallbackTime.description: The earliest time at which to call the selling partner.

latestCallbackTime.description: The latest time at which to call the selling partner.

CallbackTiming.description: The time window for an appointment callback

nextToken.description: A token to retrieve the next page of results. The response includes `nextToken` when the number of results exceeds the specified `pageSize` value. To get the next page of results, call the operation with this token and include the same arguments as the call that produced the token. To get a complete list, call this operation until `nextToken` is null. Note that this operation can return empty pages.

contactId.description: A unique identifier for the contact

channel.description: The contact channel for communication between the selling partner and Amazon.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: A phone call contact.
A chat contact.
An email contact.

createdDate.description: The time at which the contact was created. In [ISO 8601](https://developer-docs.amazon/sp-api/docs/iso-8601) format.

message.description: The email body of the contact.

attachments.description: All attachments included in the contact.

EmailContent.description: The content of an email contact.

displayName.description: The human-readable name of the participant.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Amazon support.
The selling partner.

Participant.description: A participant for a single-directional communication between a selling partner and Amazon support.

downloadUrl.description: The download link to the attachment file. The `downloadUrl` is included in the response if available. If there is a failure to return the `downloadUrl`, this field is not included in the response. The `downloadUrl` expires after 15 minutes.

callNotes.description: Notes that summarize the phone call, provided by Amazon support

PhoneContent.description: The content for a phone contact.

events.description: A list of events that make up the chat contact. Not all chat contacts are broken into chat events, and it is recommended to fallback on the `transcript` when `events` is empty.

transcript.description: The human-readable transcript of the chat contact.
transcript.example: 2024-12-23T15:02:00.171Z SellingPartnerName I'm having an issue with my Listing\n\n2024-12-23T15:02:57.627Z Amazon Associated Kyle Hello

ChatContent.description: The content for a chat contact.

timestamp.description: The time at which the event occurred.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: A message was sent.
A file was attached.
A participant joined the chat.
A participant left the chat.
A participant is idle in the chat.
The chat has ended.

message.description: The message from the chat event. Only present if the event type is `MESSAGE`.

attachments.description: All attachments included in the event. Only present if the event type is `ATTACHMENT`.

ChatEvent.description: A single event from a chat contact.
